run_eval_fastRNN_model: run evaluation of a consolidated fastRNN model using lm_eval harness and save results to JSON
run_eval_with_config: run the eval.py CLI with a YAML config file and optional dot-list overrides for EvalArgs
launch_eval_with_args: launch evaluation by passing an EvalArgs config with checkpoint dir, generator, and harness settings
review_EvalArgs_dataclass: review the EvalArgs dataclass fields including ckpt_dir, generator, harness, validation, and global_step
review_launch_eval_function: review the launch_eval function that consolidates checkpoints, loads models, runs lm_eval, and logs metrics
